answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 64916 Country: India Title: Accidentally my car ran over a pigeon Question: I accidentally ran over a pigeon while driving on road, I feel very bad and its painful for me. I am afraid of Allah. What is the way of kaffarah etc? Answer ID: 64916 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 542/542/SD=07/1437) If the pigeon came under your car without your intention then there is neither a sin, nor kaffarah on you. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
